description: Fresh EN aquarium operations admission domain.

units.title: Biological filtration
units.text: The biological filter converts toxic ammonia first to nitrite and then to nitrate through nitrifying bacteria. Flow through the filter is checked during every morning inspection.

units.title: New animal quarantine
units.text: New fish are kept in a separate quarantine system before joining established displays because isolation reduces the chance of introducing infectious disease. Quarantine tanks use dedicated nets and siphons.

units.title: Feeding observation
units.text: Keepers remain at the exhibit during feeding so they can observe appetite and unusual behavior. Uneaten food is removed after the observation period.

units.title: Temperature response
units.text: If a display temperature rises unexpectedly, the keeper first confirms the reading with a second calibrated thermometer before changing life-support settings. The incident is recorded in the daily log.

units.title: Lighting schedule
units.text: Display lighting follows a timed day-night schedule to avoid abrupt changes for animals. Decorative lights are switched off during veterinary examinations.

units.title: Salinity checks
units.text: Marine-system salinity is measured with a calibrated refractometer before large water changes. The result is written beside the replacement-water batch record.
